Extra grant for eligible battery storage systems.

  • Grant must be approved before work begins and installation completed within 8 months
  • A post-installation BER is required for final payment

SEAI Non-Domestic Microgen

Up to €325,200 for systems from 1 kWp to 1 MWp.

Enhanced rates for new applications between 7 October 2026 and 6 July 2027. The final grant is the lower of the band amount or 45% of eligible invoiced installation cost.

  • Businesses, farms, schools, community centres, public bodies and non-profits
  • Apply online to SEAI before installation, with an SEAI-registered installer
  • Work must not begin until SEAI issues a grant offer
  • Battery storage is not covered by this grant
